packageRules.description: Keep all Docker base images (node/rust builders + chainguard glibc-dynamic runtime) in one PR so builder and runtime never desync — the rust builder's glibc must not get ahead of the runtime's.

Hold jiff below 1.0: croner 4 is built against jiff 0.2 and exchanges jiff zoned datetimes with the scheduler, so both must move in one change. Delete this rule when croner supports jiff 1.0: https://github.com/Hexagon/croner-rust/issues/76
